info.title: Modusign Universal API
info.description: Modusign is an e-signature API for managing signature requests, templates, embedded signing flows, labels, webhooks, subscriptions, and file uploads over HTTP Basic auth.

put.description: Adds a label to a document in Modusign.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

labelIds[].description: One to five Modusign label IDs to attach to the document.

success.description: Whether the labels were successfully attached to the document.
